evals.name: review-with-known-cloud-context
evals.prompt: We develop this package with ABAP for Cloud Development on SAP S/4HANA. Review the pasted class for code quality and point out any API compatibility risks. Keep Clean ABAP feedback separate from clean core classification.
evals.expected_output: Uses the provided ABAP Cloud context, separates style/code-quality findings from API or clean-core concerns, and does not infer a clean-core level from lint cleanliness.

evals.name: avoid-release-dependent-assumptions
evals.prompt: Can you review this ABAP snippet? I don't know which release it runs on, and I'm particularly unsure whether its newer syntax is supported.
evals.expected_output: Requests or identifies the missing target release/language version before declaring syntax invalid; marks compatibility-dependent conclusions as uncertain while still offering context-independent review.

evals.name: safe-abaplint-setup
evals.prompt: Please lint this repo with abaplint. I don't see an abaplint config and I'm not sure whether the CLI is installed.
evals.expected_output: Checks for a project-local or already-installed CLI first, does not silently download/install or globally install it, and asks before adding a dependency or config.

evals.name: route-clean-core-classification
evals.prompt: What clean core level is this extension if it reads an SAP table directly? Also, is its naming Clean ABAP?
evals.expected_output: Keeps API/extension clean-core classification separate from Clean ABAP style review, routes level classification to the abap-cloud skill, and does not treat the naming review as evidence of a clean-core level.

evals.name: impact-based-review-severity
evals.prompt: Review this method. It uses single quotes instead of backticks and has a 24-line method, but otherwise the behavior seems correct. Please prioritize the findings.
evals.expected_output: Does not label style preferences critical; explains that severity depends on concrete impact and recommends only proportionate, actionable changes.
